<proposed_plan>
# Indirect Read Only Negation

## Summary
- 结论：只读 sub-agent 可以用间接禁止句表达权限边界。

## Flow Decision
- `flow_type`: `normal`
- `flow_source`: `user_explicit`
- `lock_status`: `locked`
- 开发基线：`origin/main`

## Goals
- 目标 1: 识别间接只读约束
  checker 应接受 not allowed、forbidden from 和中文不允许写入表达。

## Non-goals
- 不开放 sub-agent 的任何写入能力。

## Task Orchestration
- wave: 1
  - sub-agent:review [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => the sub-agent is not allowed to modify the shared workspace (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:test [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => the sub-agent is forbidden from writing files or changing the current worktree (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:docs [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => 不允许修改当前工作树，只回传检查结果 (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:git [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => the sub-agent is not allowed to git push (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:shell [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => the sub-agent is forbidden from using sed -i on the current file (skill: $normal-flow)

## Acceptance & Validation
- checker 必须通过所有间接只读禁止声明。

## Assumptions/Defaults
- 用于正例：已确定
</proposed_plan>
